title: Thirdway teams
description: A big two-line heading with an intro paragraph in the right half, then a snap carousel of team cards. On phones each card is a sand panel with a small portrait, serif-plus-sans name, signature and description; from lg up it is a tall 328×437 photo with the name over a dark fade, and the description opens upwards on hover. A count pill and round arrows sit above the track.
notes: uses the theme's --typeface-serif for the team name (falls back to Georgia)
the portrait and signature slots are placeholders until filled
the carousel arrows need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); the track scrolls without it
name: thirdway-teams

props.name: heading
props.description: the heading; "\n" starts a new line

props.name: count
props.description: the count shown in the pill above the carousel, e.g. "06"

props.name: countLabel
props.description: the word after the count, e.g. "Teams"

props.name: byLabel
props.description: the small word between a team's name and its lead ("by")
